conventions.case_frame: LDraw LDU per case: -Y up, the case front faces -Z (towards the overview camera), ground (top of the base) at y = 0. Each control's default 0 is the built pose.
conventions.wind: Blows toward +X (LDraw and Blender). Gusts travel along +X at GUST_SPEED LDU/frame from X0; a joint at field x feels the wind (x - X0)/GUST_SPEED frames after the field origin.
conventions.signs: + = downwind (tip moves +X) for lean/bend joints; + = tip rises (-Y) for hinged leaves and fronds; twist/spin joints turn right-handed about the axis stated in each control's description.
conventions.joints: real = a LEGO connection that allows this rotation (ball socket, clip on bar, bar or pin in a hole, stud); flex_approx = a rigid-part tilt standing in for bending plastic, at most 0.17 rad.
conventions.rules: Every clip starts at rest and ends at rest (spins on a symmetric step); breeze clips loop seamlessly over frames 25-217.

styles.whip_chain: Segmented trunk or vine: each joint lags the one below and swings further, so a bend travels to the tip like a whip
styles.crown_twist: A crown or head turns back and forth about its stem from asymmetric drag
styles.leaf_flex: Large leaves lift and droop at their roots; upwind leaves are lifted, downwind leaves flattened
styles.frond_flap: Clip-hinged fronds flap about their bars, staggered in time
styles.cane_sway: Tall rigid canes lean on ball joints, each at its own (height-dependent) frequency
styles.rustle: Small leaf pieces jiggle about their bar or stud, fast and out of phase
styles.stem_lean: A thin stem leans downwind and springs back (flex_approx)
styles.twirl: Flower heads turn back and forth on their pins
styles.heavy_nod: A heavy head on a hinge: slow, lightly damped nod with overshoot
styles.pinwheel_spin: Free spin about a bar facing the wind, speed following the gusts
styles.ripple_wave: A field of identical stems: the gust front makes a visible wave cross it
styles.lean_recover: Well damped lean with the gusts and recovery, no lingering oscillation
styles.two_level: A slow stalk carries fast leaves (two natural frequencies in one plant)
styles.hanging_chain: A hanging flexible chain: the bottom swings most and lags the top
styles.domino_gust: A row along the wind: each element starts later (gust front plus shelter lag)
styles.branch_bounce: Hinged branches bounce springily (low damping, higher frequency)
styles.shiver: Pendant leaves tremble fast with small amplitude (aspen)
styles.directional: Identical leaves react by their facing: upwind fold over, downwind flatten, cross-wind flutter
styles.bouquet_jiggle: Several stems and heads in one vase, each with its own small motion
styles.tier_cascade: Tiers stacked on one bar twist one after another (helical lag up the stack)
styles.rope_rock: A vine strung between two clips rocks about the line through them
styles.pendulum_swing: Identical hanging pendulums: the passing gust sets their phase
styles.sheltered_flicker: Ground plants ignore the breeze and only flick in gusts (drive threshold)
styles.weathervane: Leaves free to turn about a vertical bar swing round to point downwind and hunt there
styles.torsion_wave: Stacked crowns on one axle twist with a lag between them
styles.gust_response: Gusty clip: rest, three gusts, rest
styles.storm_push: Storm clip: strong mean push (soft-limited at the range ends) with hard gusts

clips.title: Ball-chain palm: breeze
clips.description: Gentle breeze (mean speed 0.42, 4 s swell; frames 25-217 loop seamlessly). The trunk bends as a whip through six ball joints (each lagging the one below), the crown twists on its spike and the four big leaves lift or flatten by their facing.

clips.title: Ball-chain palm: gusty
clips.description: Gusty wind: picks up, three gusts sweep across the field from the left, then dies away. The trunk bends as a whip through six ball joints (each lagging the one below), the crown twists on its spike and the four big leaves lift or flatten by their facing.

clips.title: Ball-chain palm: storm
clips.description: Storm: strong steady push with four hard gusts and cross-wind turbulence, then calm. The trunk bends as a whip through six ball joints (each lagging the one below), the crown twists on its spike and the four big leaves lift or flatten by their facing.

clips.title: Palm crowns on an axle: breeze
clips.description: Gentle breeze (mean speed 0.42, 4 s swell; frames 25-217 loop seamlessly). The two crowns twist on the axle, the upper one lagging (a torsion wave).

clips.title: Palm crowns on an axle: gusty
clips.description: Gusty wind: picks up, three gusts sweep across the field from the left, then dies away. The two crowns twist on the axle, the upper one lagging (a torsion wave).
